description: Pixel art portrait, head and shoulders, of a ship's AI shown as a hologram of a woman's face, calm, half-lidded and mildly unimpressed, a dry little almost-smile, short hair, facing the viewer, made of warm amber projector light with soft scanlines, like a heat glow, faint glitch at the edges, projected inside a dark ship console with a few cold indicator lights, deep indigo dark filling every edge, no lettering
